tree: saved strictly quarterly walk-forward NL02; 3 leaves, 60 trees; no refitting

definitions.Z: per signal-date 1%/99% winsorisation followed by population z-score; no full-sample time-series normalization
definitions.q: same-date average-rank percentile of saved causal NL02 predictions
definitions.P03_HYSTERESIS_F: Z(Z(f)-0.25*h); h enters at q<0.15, exits at q>0.25, retains prior state otherwise, starts false
definitions.pool: arithmetic mean of four unchanged normalized incumbent seats and the normalized corrected F seat

missing_tree_policy: keep incumbent correction zero; reset hysteresis false when seat or tree unavailable
hysteresis_recent_history: construct state over complete history before slicing recent window
scope: archived common-universe pool diagnostic, not new formal full-universe platform-equivalent reproduction
core_contract: SH/SZ full-A source, qfq, total_mv, 20180101 warmup, saved signal dates, close(t+1)->close(t+11), 10 groups, factor_valid benchmark, 0.003 one-way cost
required_outputs: member turnover and drift-weight turnover separately

acceptance.size_guard: absolute size rho does not increase and rank-bucket-neutral net does not decrease
acceptance.recent_window: report separately; candidate with negative recent A+C proxy is ineligible for direct platform progression
acceptance.score: A+C sensitivity positive, B not presumed; no official incremental-score claim
acceptance.platform_confirmation: separate approval only after local shortlist
